decisions.rationale: NOA 2025 ($116,598) and pay stub (about $119.5k annualized) fall materially short of the stated $158,000 and contradict the letter's $165,964, so escalate.
Funds appear seasoned and sufficient, but an unexplained $3,080 deposit on 4 July needs review under the large/unusual deposit rule.
Recent signed letterhead letter confirms permanent full-time employment since 2017 with probation completed.
Ratios computed on stated $158,000 look compliant (GDS about 35%, TDS about 43%) but documented income is much lower, which would breach limits.
